truth: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
lie: A group of flamingos is called a parade.

truth: Honey never spoils.
lie: Honey spoils after about two years.

truth: Octopuses have three hearts.
lie: Octopuses have two hearts.

truth: Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not.
lie: Strawberries are berries, but bananas are not.

truth: The Eiffel Tower can grow taller in summer.
lie: The Eiffel Tower shrinks in summer.

truth: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
lie: A year on Venus is longer than a day on Venus.

truth: Sharks existed before trees.
lie: Trees existed before sharks.

truth: The unicorn is Scotland's national animal.
lie: The dragon is Scotland's national animal.

truth: Wombat poop is cube-shaped.
lie: Wombat poop is perfectly round.

truth: There are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on Earth.
lie: There are more grains of sand on Earth than stars in the universe.

truth: A snail can sleep for three years.
lie: A snail can only sleep for three days.

truth: The first oranges were not orange.
lie: The first oranges were bright orange.

truth: A jiffy is an actual unit of time.
lie: A jiffy is not a real unit of time.

truth: Cows have best friends and get stressed when separated.
lie: Cows are solitary and prefer no company.

truth: The inventor of the Pringles can was buried in one.
lie: The inventor of the Pringles can was buried with a potato.

truth: A cloud can weigh more than a million pounds.
lie: A cloud weighs less than a pound.

truth: The Great Wall of China is not visible from space with the naked eye.
lie: The Great Wall of China is the only man-made object visible from space.

truth: A crocodile cannot stick its tongue out.
lie: A crocodile can stick its tongue out like a snake.

truth: The dot over the letter i is called a tittle.
lie: The dot over the letter i is called a serif.

truth: Sea otters hold hands while sleeping.
lie: Sea otters sleep alone and avoid touch.

truth: The shortest war in history lasted 38 minutes.
lie: The shortest war in history lasted 38 days.

truth: A group of crows is called a murder.
lie: A group of crows is called a flock.

truth: A day on Mercury is longer than its year.
lie: A year on Mercury is longer than its day.

truth: The tongue is the strongest muscle in the human body relative to its size.
lie: The tongue is the weakest muscle in the human body.
